notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello travelers to Yariv, 


As we work on the main game, we are implementing numerous improvements and moving closer to our final vision. 

However, we don't want to keep it from you, so we've decided to update the demo and give you a small glimpse of our work behind the scenes. 


The new demo contains: 
New Content --------------------------------------------------------------

Reworked texture for almost every object in the game!

New and more polished tutorial (Black and White Forest)

New tree models in the forest area 

Improvements ------------------------------------------------------------

Improvements to Mask Altar UI 

Better scrolling in menus with the mouse scroll 

Better display of shield's passive defence in inventory 

Changes ------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Broken Sword received a damage and reach buff 

Barrels' durability changed: 150HP --> 70HP 

Burn and poison deal more damage to enemies 

Glitches ------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Brawler ring HP decrease bug fixed 

More minor bug fixes



Play the new demo for yourself and let us know what you think - either as a Steam review or in our active Discord: https://discord.com/invite/drJzkyDeBa



I wish you great adventures in Yariv!
